envelope.description: Hold one write root in validation and completion

body.title: Hold one write root in validation and completion
body.summary: Change runValidateSession so the turn holds one write root for the TESTS write, storyWorkflowFiles and the BUILD persist, and both best-effort catches rethrow MissingAnchorError and return a BuildStepError with code missing-anchor while every other ledger failure stays best-effort. Change ensureBuildRecordOnCompletion to pass write intent. Add the validate-anchor and completion-anchor tests.
acceptanceChecks: the first headless validate call with a failing judge keeps the TESTS evidence and a retry on a later day files BUILD in the same folder
an injected TESTS write failure with a successful judge returns the verdict and writes a stamped BUILD
a read-intent MissingAnchorError returns the missing-anchor error and an ordinary ledger failure still returns the verdict
completion on a headless work item writes the BUILD record
